# CANDIDATE: LATE_AFTERNOON_VIX_MEAN_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated VIX combined with overbought RSI and a bearish engulfing candle predicts a short‑term mean‑reversion pullback. This edge exists because high VIX indicates fear-driven overextension, RSI > 70 signals overbought conditions, and a bearish engulfing candle confirms immediate selling pressure, creating a high-probability short-term reversion to the mean.

## Mechanism

From 13:30 to 15:00 ET, if VIX > 25, RSI(14) > 70, and a bearish engulfing candle occurs (current close < open, current body > prior body, current close < prior open), enter short at the close of that bar. Exit uses a chart-stop at the recent swing high prior to entry, an initial target at 1R (risk-reward), and a runner trailed at 10% from the highest close reached after entry.
